$comment: Maps a Playwright screenshot name (from toHaveScreenshot('NAME.png')) to its destination under assets/img/. `npm run sync-docs` copies each captured baseline to its destination. Unlike the agentgateway harness, destinations here are a single path rather than a light/dark pair, and the guides point both reuse-image shortcodes at the one asset. That was originally because Keycloak 22 shipped no dark console; since Keycloak 24 there is one and it follows prefers-color-scheme, so playwright.config.ts now pins `use.colorScheme` to light to keep the captures deterministic. Publishing a real dark set means widening each entry to {"light": ..., "dark": ...}, adding the theme dimension to playwright.config.ts, and repointing the 8 reuse-image-dark calls in security/keycloak/setup.md — do it as its own change, not inside a version bump. A capture with no entry here is still diffed for regression but never reaches the docs.
